notes: Web 399 — LIVE-MILES-CLOUD-PERSIST-NOV10 (owner Nov 10, 2026 09:22 CST, in his hands: he cleared the app cache + force-stopped; on relaunch the dashboard read 'Miles (live): 0.2 km' — the morning's accrued miles (13.7 km at 09:00, more since) were gone, while the session timer and the day's counted load restored. His order: live miles must be stored in the cloud and must never go back to zero when the cache is cleared). CONVICTED by tools/live-miles-cloud-persist-nov10-test.js (failing-first on live 396 bytes: 10 passed / 13 failed; 23/23 here): the running total accrued in the miles engine and persisted ONLY into the local store (js/miles.js persist() -> localStorage 'mt_livemiles', 10 s throttle); the one cloud copy was cloudsync's telemetry document — a shed, best-effort side-channel whose restore rides the pull-merge + adoption seams — and the tracker record, the session's own cloud face (re-saved every minute a session runs since v220, stamp-arbitrated in the pull, the record that DID restore his session that morning), carried no miles at all. THE FIX: (1) WRITE — js/app.js stampLiveMilesOnTracker(), called from trackerSave(): a live session's fix-backed total (recordKmFor first, the live engine's currentKm as the v389 fallback — no number invented when neither has a fix) is stamped onto the tracker record itself as liveMilesM / liveMilesAt / liveMilesSid on the session's existing save cadence (transitions + the v220 minute re-save) and rides its debounced push; monotonic within the session, replaced when the session changes, REMOVED when the tracker goes idle — a closed day presents no floor. (2) RESTORE — js/miles.js applyCloudFloor(key), called at the head of startDay and inside reseedFromStore: when the store's tracker names a LIVE session (running/paused) whose pinned sessionId matches the key (the v361 +/-5 s pin family) with a stamp from that session's own day, the day record is raised to at least the stamped metres — created from the floor when none survives, labelled cloudFloorM (persist() preserves the label), its counted-coverage span seeded [session start - the v174 fragment-adoption slack, stamp] so the original breadcrumb trail folded later dedupes instead of double-counting. The floor only ever RAISES: a local record already ahead stands; idle trackers, other sessions and other days present no floor; the date-keyed day watch takes none. (3) SEAM — the shell's after-pull adoption now also fires on a 'tracker' change, so a pull landing the session record after the engines began still reseeds. Throttle choice: the session's own minute cadence — no new write path, no write storm; the stamp is three small numbers on a record that already syncs. REGRESSIONS: the miles/session family at its pristine standings; the only flips are the designed ship-coherence pins of superseded suites (v397's tile pins, as v389's flipped before it). index pins: app.js 398 -> 399, miles.js 388 -> 399 (shifttrack stays 398). version.json built from the LIVE web-398 file: native version 74 + apkUrl meticulous-v74.apk preserved (gen 74 untouched), webVersion 398 -> 399, files map updated for js/app.js + js/miles.js + index.html only.
